body:
Quick mode — 1 round, 5 Cursor specialists + generic Codex.

Round 1 accepted 4 findings (2 important, 1 latent, 1 nit); all were doc-clarity fixes < 15 LOC each.

## Accepted Findings
- Structure/Correctness: Voter Output Format OOS_N vs FINDING_N path-dependency → fixed
- Correctness: OOS on the Ballot opening sentence misleads on ID prefix → fixed
- Structure (latent): [OOS] alternative marker not documented → added
- Structure (nit): Ballot Format line 17 over-implies both parsers run on each ballot → clarified

Round stopped after round 1 (non-substantial).
